description: About 200 tokens of text, then 120 s of silence, then the rest. The second request answers at once.
harness: The idle watchdog (60 s local, 120 s cloud) fires; cancel and continue from the partial text like a disconnect; at most 2 per step.

steps.text: The renderer owns the frame loop: it polls the window, advances the simulation by a fixed step and presents. Player movement is integrated with explicit Euler in player_update, so the position changes by velocity times dt.
